text: What's the ugliest thing in view? Don't say your reflection.
Find the dustiest thing near you. When did you give up?
What's the weirdest stain within ten feet? No forensics needed.
Loudest thing you can hear. Rate its audacity, 1-10.
What object nearby is judging you right now? It's something.
Sniff the air. Report your findings. Be brave.
What's the most expensive thing in sight you didn't pay for?
Nearest object that would hurt most to step on barefoot?
What's been 'about to be thrown out' for days now? It's thriving.
Which chair here has seen things? Describe them.
What's something nearby someone clearly loves more than it deserves?
Pick a stranger nearby. Assign them a secret. Be generous.
What would a raccoon steal from here first? It has taste.
What in this place is held together by hope and tape?
What does this place sound like when nobody's performing?
Explain your surroundings to a Victorian ghost. Start with the microwave.
What here would confuse an archaeologist in 3,000 years?
Who took care of this place before you? Were they better at it?
What in your daily view will you miss when it's gone? Notice it now.
What does this place know about you that nobody else does?
When did you stop actually looking at where you live?
What's the thing you keep meaning to fix? What's it really about?
What corner of your world feels most like you?
What would ten-years-older you photograph here?
Where do you feel most yourself? And why aren't you there more?
Worst thing to burp up later?
What did you overthink today? Besides this question.
Pettiest grudge you serviced today?
What did you Google today that bored your FBI agent?
Dumbest thing you did today that worked anyway?
What did you eat standing over the sink like a raccoon?
Best five minutes of your day. The bar can be low.
What did you almost text but wisely didn't? Wisely, right?
How many times did you apologize today for existing near someone?
Today's most heroic act of minimum effort?
What conversation is still living rent-free in your head?
What did you handle like an actual adult today? Rare. Document it.
What drained you today? Be honest about whether you volunteered.
What's something you're pretending is fine? It can hear you.
Small kindness you witnessed this week. Yes, they still happen.
What decision are you re-deciding for the fifth time?
What felt like the old you today, for better or worse?
What did you want more of today and didn't ask for?
What are you quietly getting better at? It shows.
What hard thing did you do once and never took credit for?
Who are you when nobody needs anything from you?
What would real rest look like right now? Not scrolling. Real rest.
What are you still carrying that ended a while ago?
What part of your life is waving for attention right now?
What do you know now that you learned the hard way?
Make a dating profile for your dog. They'll get more likes than you.
What's your most indefensible food opinion? Defend it anyway.
What's your walk-up song? Be serious. This matters.
Most embarrassing app on your phone? Screen time counts double.
What's your go-to fake-busy activity when someone's watching?
What snack could end a friendship if someone took the last one?
What's in your bag right now that has no explanation?
What's your signature buffet move? Everyone has one. Yours is worse.
What word do you say weird? Everyone's too polite to tell you.
Last photo in your camera roll: explain yourself.
What's a routine actually working for you? Brag a little.
What do you like now that you used to mock? Growth. Gross.
Who makes you feel most like yourself? Do they know?
What's a secret rule you live by that you've never said out loud?
What skill took you embarrassingly long to learn? It still counts.
What tiny tradition do you actually keep? Defend its honor.
What purchase do you still think about? The one that got away.
What part of your week is sacred? Protect it accordingly.
What do you need more of that you've stopped asking for?
What promise to yourself have you actually kept? Take the win.
What do you love enough to be scared of losing?
What's changed in you that nobody's caught up to yet?
What would you tell the you from exactly one year ago?
What does home mean right now? Not the address. The feeling.
Who's seen you at your worst and stayed?
Write your morning's one-star review. Be brutal. It deserves it.
Name the sitcom set in your current location. Tagline required.
Your day in exactly five words. Choose violence or don't.
What would your pet post about you if they had thumbs?
Give your mood a paint-swatch name. 'Beige Despair' is taken.
Write the villain origin story of your last minor inconvenience.
Caption the last hour like a nature documentary. The creature is you.
Invent a scented candle based on today. Name and notes, please.
Your autobiography title. Subtitle optional but encouraged.
Write the group chat's reaction to your day. Include the thumbs-up guy.
Write the back-cover blurb for this month of your life. Sell it.
If your week were a meal, which course are you on? Is dessert coming?
Soundtrack for your week: one song. Wrong answers exist.
Describe someone you love without naming them. Face descriptions are cheating.
Write a postcard from today to yourself last winter. Gloat if applicable.
Explain your current problem as a fable. The moral can be dumb.
If your home had a narrator, what would they gently roast?
Your energy level as a landscape. 'Swamp' is a valid answer.
Write the toast at your 80th birthday. What do they thank you for?
Introduce the person you're becoming to an old friend.
Your last five years as a museum exhibit. Name the rooms.
Write the letter you'll never send. Start with the second sentence.
Your younger self visits today. What do you show them first?
What story about yourself deserves a more honest telling?
Pick a moment you'd relive at half speed. What do you notice?
Rank your last 3 meals. One of them knows what it did.
Rank 3 chores by post-chore smugness.
Rank the 3 apps you opened most today. They keep receipts.
Rank 3 fictional places you'd move to tomorrow. Rent-free, obviously.
Rank 3 sounds that should be illegal.
Rank your last 3 texts by effort. Someone's getting robbed.
Rank 3 smells that teleport you somewhere. Gas station counts.
Rank the 3 objects on your nightstand. The loser gets exiled.
Rank 3 excuses you've deployed this month by believability.
Rank 3 breakfast foods you'd defend in court. Pro bono.
Rank the last 3 songs you played. One is spreading rumors about you.
Rank 3 ways you procrastinated this week. Doing one now? Thought so.
Rank 3 people you'd call from jail. They already know who they are.
Rank 3 weather conditions by personality. Drizzle is a coward.
Rank the 3 best pockets of your day. Naps qualify.
Rank 3 drinks by loyalty. Water is doing all the work.
Rank 3 childhood snacks that still hold up under scrutiny.
Rank your 3 open tabs. Close the loser. Do it. Now.
Rank 3 places you've fallen asleep that weren't beds.
Rank 3 purchases under $10 that changed your life. Cheap thrills count.
Rank 3 things you'd grab in a small, polite fire.
Rank 3 hills you'd actually die on. Small hills count.
Rank 3 conversations you're avoiding. Gently.
Rank 3 versions of yourself from this week. Be kind to Tuesday's.
Rank 3 compliments you've received by shelf life.
